title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING WELCOME PASS
description: The update treats combat feel and monetization pressure as one shared pacing problem. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Early sessions now surface clearer genre hooks for players who have not memorized the wiki by birth.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. The game waved at strangers without asking them to craft a spreadsheet first.

title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING EXPERT MODE
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. New systems lean into late-game complexity for players already fluent in the existing disaster.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. The audience got smaller, sharper, and much harder to onboard at parties.

title: MINIMAL GUIDANCE MODE WELCOME PASS
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Several prompts have been removed so discovery can emerge naturally from confusion and patch forum archaeology. Early sessions now surface clearer genre hooks for players who have not memorized the wiki by birth.
consequence: The tutorial got shorter. So did the time before players asked what was happening. The game waved at strangers without asking them to craft a spreadsheet first.
